verdict.rationale: Zapier's Platform CLI documents webhooks as a building block for integrations, and one community user reports that Zapier made it 'very easy to implement a webhook'. Neither item clearly documents how a programmatic consumer registers outbound HTTP callbacks to subscribe to Zapier events, so support is thin and its direction is ambiguous. missing for 10: documented registrable outbound webhook subscriptions, event catalog/payload docs, subscription management (create/list/delete), delivery and retry semantics, and hands-on corroboration of event delivery to a consumer endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Zapier Platform CLI enables developers to build integrations using Node.js v22, OAuth1/OAuth2 authentication, webhooks, polling triggers, and HTTP middleware.
I am using Zapier because their service was very easy to implement a webhook for what I needed
